List without when
.
Here _be_:

- trolls
- other creatures
.
<p>Here <em>be</em>:</p>
<ul>
<li>trolls</li>
<li>other creatures</li>
</ul>
.

Simple list
.
Here _be_:

- [[when dragons]] dragonics
- other creatures ((when black))black((/when))
.
<p>Here <em>be</em>:</p>
<ul>
<li when="dragons">dragonics</li>
<li>other creatures <span when="black">black</span></li>
</ul>
.

More conditionals inside list item
.
Here _be_:

- [[when dragons]] dragonics
- [[when trolls]] ((when black))black((/when)) trolls
- other creatures
.
<p>Here <em>be</em>:</p>
<ul>
<li when="dragons">dragonics</li>
<li when="trolls"><span when="black">black</span> trolls</li>
<li>other creatures</li>
</ul>
.
